A_operator_events.reason: June 25 and July 1 operator cases were themselves used to define the Forest City controller (high-RH mixing; hot/dry evaporative; DX backup unused). They are source-implementation checks, not independent predictive validations.
A_operator_events.scientific_consequence: Event PASS cannot be counted as out-of-sample evidence that the controller predicts unseen Forest City behavior.

B_summer_dx.old: full-calendar summer DX interpretation from v1 JJA
B_summer_dx.reason: KFQD has no records before 2012-06-21; 955 JJA hours were WEATHER_MISSING.
B_summer_dx.scientific_consequence: Do not claim full-calendar summer until missing-weather robustness is assessed with independent station replications.

C_cross_climate.reason: v1 compared PRN1 Q2 frozen modes to Forest City JJA KFQD. Seasons differed. No mutually exclusive taxonomy. No identified Forest City airflow/water boundary.

D_overlapping_prn_filters.consequence: v1 Prineville-vs-Forest-City mode fractions were not a clean probability comparison.
D_overlapping_prn_filters.old_method: PRN categories constructed by overlapping substring searches (HUMID, EVAP, MIX|RH_OR)

E_delta_t.do_not: equate 35F IT/server DeltaT with AHU or effective facility DeltaT

F_frc1_address.note: Original-campus street-address mapping was unresolved in v1 and remains a set, not a single PIN.
